Take any category <MATH_0001> constructed as in
Sets, Lemma <REF_0001>
starting with the set of schemes <MATH_0002>. Choose any set of
coverings <MATH_0003> on <MATH_0004> as in
Sets, Lemma <REF_0002>
starting with the category <MATH_0005> and the class of fppf
coverings. Let <MATH_0006> denote the big fppf site so
obtained. Next, for <MATH_0007>
let <MATH_0008> have the same underlying category as
<MATH_0009> with coverings
<MATH_0010> simply the subset of
<MATH_0011>-coverings. It is straightforward to check that this gives rise
to a big site <MATH_0012>.
